data.label: Proposed system delivers operational coverage…
data.statement: Proposed system delivers operational coverage on automotive IDS — some closed configuration of {orthogonal-channel ensemble, decoupled-approval gate, jointly-fit calibration apparatus, deployable compression} delivers a class-conditional rejection guarantee on the active subset, respecting the applicable hardware, regulatory, and operational constraints. (Caveat — no specific operational success threshold committed yet, e.g. detection-rate floor at a given abstain-rate ceiling on a named dataset; deferred to a content-side authoring pass.)

data.label: Operational rejection guarantee — the…
data.statement: Operational rejection guarantee — the deployed system has class-conditional coverage on its active subset, distribution-free. Names no specific predictor; closed by exhibiting any one realization (existence claim).

data.label: Joint-fit principle — all trust…
data.statement: Joint-fit principle — all trust thresholds, gates, and policy parameters must be jointly fit on a single held-out natural-distribution split. Independent fitting voids coverage (cf. the coverage-void result, N03).

data.label: Coverage void under independent calibration…
data.statement: Coverage void under independent calibration — independent fitting of the conformal abstain rule and the drift detector can simultaneously fire and suppress on the same input, voiding operational coverage. Asserted in the candidacy report; not yet derived from CAN data.

data.label: Constraint-respecting deployable compression — some…
data.statement: Constraint-respecting deployable compression — some compression strategy reduces the trained ensemble to a footprint that respects the hardware envelope and per-window latency constraint. Existence claim.

data.label: Per-class conformal abstain + safety…
data.statement: Per-class conformal abstain + safety shield + joint apparatus closes the operational rejection guarantee for the candidacy's specific configuration.

data.label: 5-threshold list (tier threshold +…
data.statement: 5-threshold list (tier threshold + 3 runtime gates + conformal alpha) jointly fit on the same held-out natural-distribution split. The candidacy's realization of the joint-fit principle.

data.label: Per-class conformal abstain — class-conditional…
data.statement: Per-class conformal abstain — class-conditional conformal predictor on the PINN-active subset.

data.label: PINN safety shield projects the…
data.statement: PINN safety shield projects the simplex so alpha_PINN ≤ lambda_physics(s_t); remaining mass redistributes across {GAT, VGAE, CWD}. One specific instantiation of the decoupled-approval principle.

data.label: Composite trust score lambda_physics =…
data.statement: Composite trust score lambda_physics = lambda_tier × V_regime × V_signal × V_residual; product over three runtime gates with thresholds co-fit on the 5-threshold apparatus.

data.label: KD pipeline with ~68× reduction…
data.statement: KD pipeline with ~68× reduction — logit-level + latent-space knowledge distillation; meets the hardware-envelope ceiling at 7 ms per CAN window on Cortex-A7.

data.label: Per-class abstain rate is operationally…
data.statement: Per-class abstain rate is operationally bounded under class imbalance. Asserted that the per-class abstain rule's rate on minority attack classes does not dominate; not yet quantified empirically nor reduced via mechanism choice. (Ding et al., OpenReview Dtxc7mlKRg).

data.label: A formal class-conditional coverage guarantee…
data.statement: A formal class-conditional coverage guarantee (N02-thesis) on a constraint-respecting compressed system (N19-thesis) using diagnostically-orthogonal channels closes the thesis.

data.label: The candidacy's specific configuration closes…
data.statement: The candidacy's specific configuration closes this abstract guarantee.

data.label: If independent calibration produces a…
data.statement: If independent calibration produces a coverage void (cf. the coverage-void result), joint fitting on a single split is the forced fix.

data.label: The KD pipeline realizes this…
data.statement: The KD pipeline realizes this abstract compression requirement.

data.label: Composing the per-class abstain rule…
data.statement: Composing the per-class abstain rule (N17) with the safety shield (N12) on the joint-fit apparatus (N01-instance) yields a class-conditional rejection bound on the PINN-active subset, conditional on operationally-bounded per-class abstain rate under class imbalance (N50).

data.label: The 5-threshold list is one…
data.statement: The 5-threshold list is one specific calibration apparatus realizing the joint-fit principle on the natural-distribution split.

data.label: Class-conditional conformal predictors with per-class…
data.statement: Class-conditional conformal predictors with per-class coverage guarantees are standard (Vovk et al. 2003); the kd-gat instantiation specializes to the PINN-active subset.

data.label: Implementing the decoupled-approval principle via…
data.statement: Implementing the decoupled-approval principle via the composite trust score yields the projection step on the simplex.

data.label: lambda_physics is the product lambda_tier…
data.statement: lambda_physics is the product lambda_tier × V_regime × V_signal × V_residual; each gate is an empirical runtime check whose validity is definitional. Joint-fit thresholds inherit from the 5-threshold apparatus.

data.label: KD capacity-gap literature (Mirzadeh 2020,…
data.statement: KD capacity-gap literature (Mirzadeh 2020, Zhang 2025) establishes that the ~68× compression ratio falls in the viable region for binary CAN classification because task complexity is bounded. Governed by the hardware-envelope constraint (K1).

data.label: GAT+VGAE byte-channel + physics chain…
data.statement: GAT+VGAE byte-channel + physics chain — the candidacy's specific orthogonal-channel realization. GAT+VGAE reads raw frames; PINN reads physics state via ByCAN. The two branches share no estimation pipeline. Empirical fact about the as-built architecture.

data.label: Decoupled approval principle — the…
data.statement: Decoupled approval principle — the signal that evaluates behavior must be independent of the signal that trains it. Goodhart-flavored auxiliary-verification principle.

data.label: Vovk et al. 2003 —…
data.statement: Vovk et al. 2003 — class-conditional conformal predictors with distribution-free per-class coverage guarantees.

data.label: KD capacity-gap law — distillation…
data.statement: KD capacity-gap law — distillation benefit degrades when the teacher–student gap grows too large; the 68× ratio is viable here because the task is bounded (binary CAN-window classification). Not a universal claim.

data.label: Regime validity gate V_regime —…
data.statement: Regime validity gate V_regime — runtime check whether the current vehicle state is inside the operating regime on which the PINN was trained. Definitional / instrumented.

data.label: Signal reliability gate V_signal —…
data.statement: Signal reliability gate V_signal — runtime check whether the ByCAN-extracted CAN signals are of sufficient quality. ByCAN signal noise propagates here. Fires on estimator drift.

data.label: Residual uncertainty gate V_residual —…
data.statement: Residual uncertainty gate V_residual — runtime check whether the PINN's residual uncertainty is tight enough to be informative. Fires on over-wide uncertainty.

data.label: Channel-disagreement principle — heterogeneous channels…
data.statement: Channel-disagreement principle — heterogeneous channels with non-overlapping estimation pipelines produce diagnostic disagreement on attack inputs. Empirical, not a theorem; structural prerequisite for any ensemble-as-arbitration design.

data.label: Hardware envelope — ARM Cortex-A7/A53;…
data.statement: Hardware envelope — ARM Cortex-A7/A53; 256–512 MB RAM; <100 mW; <50–100 ms latency; 173K FP32 parameter ceiling at 7 ms per CAN window.

data.label: Regulatory constraints — ISO 26262…
data.statement: Regulatory constraints — ISO 26262 ASIL C/D (Part 6) requires structural code coverage, bidirectional V-model traceability, and FFI evidence for mixed-criticality ECUs; black-box models cannot supply these. ISO/PAS 8800:2024 mandates runtime monitor and OOD detection. UN R155 §7.3.7 mandates vehicle-resident IDS for EU type-approval (since 07/2022; all new EU vehicles since 07/2024).

data.label: Operational constraints — (K5) CAN…
data.statement: Operational constraints — (K5) CAN protocol lacks authentication; injected frames are indistinguishable at the protocol level. (K6) Detection is per-CAN-window (W=100 messages, ~1 ms). (K7) Severe class imbalance 36:1–927:1 forces class-conditional evaluation. (K8) ByCAN recovers ~80% slicing / ~69% labeling accuracy; tier-3 noise on physical-state extraction. (K9) Cross-vehicle generalization is declared orthogonal future work.

gaps.remedy: Derive simultaneous fire+suppress on CAN data under independent fitting.

Three options: (a) bound the per-class abstain rate empirically under class imbalance and quantify operational impact; (b) replace N17 with a pooled-class conformal mechanism with imbalance correction; (c) accept the rate explicitly in the candidacy text. Ding et al. (OpenReview Dtxc7mlKRg) documents formal instability of classwise conformal predictors under heavy imbalance.
